easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Planar Incision.
description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Planar Incision, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Planar Incision, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.
